channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Your Trust Hosts Family Activities During October Half Term in Rochdale
item.description: Your Trust is offering a variety of family-friendly activities across multiple venues in Rochdale this October half term, including a special Halloween pool party.

item.title: From six modems to 580 staff: Rochdale’s Zen Internet puts people and planet alongside profit
item.description: Rochdale’s Zen Internet grew from £5,000 and six dial-up modems into a national broadband provider. Its B Corp approach puts customers, staff and the environment alongside profit.

item.title: The Healey Dell prophecy: Eleanor Byron, Mother Bagden and what the records actually show
item.description: A short guide to the strange local tale that a Lady Eleanor was “maid, wife and widow in one day” — what early collectors wrote, what the Heritage Centre tells visitors, and what survives as documentary fact.

item.title: Roadworks Scheduled on Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough on 6 November 2026
item.description: Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough will be temporarily closed for roadworks starting on 6 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Rochdale selected for £9.4m children’s mental health pilot
item.description: Breaking: Rochdale will join Stockport and Tameside in Care Together, bringing NHS mental health professionals into children’s social care teams from early 2027.

item.title: Planning Approved for New £11.4 Million Special Needs School in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Council has received planning permission to build a new special needs school, set to open in 2028, aimed at supporting children with complex needs.

item.description: 1 new story in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Plans for 17-Storey Tower Next to Historic Marble Arch Pub Rejected
item.description: Councillors have rejected a proposal for a 17-storey tower block beside the Grade II-listed Marble Arch pub in Manchester, citing concerns over its impact on the historic site.

item.title: Rochdale Council Generates Nearly £3 Million from Parking Fines Over Three Years
item.description: Rochdale Council has collected £2.88 million from parking fines since 2023, with the highest revenue year being 2025. The funds are reinvested into local road infrastructure.

item.title: Rochdale Woman Reaches Semi-Finals in National Weight Loss Competition After Losing Over 12 Stone
item.description: Vikki Gurney's remarkable weight loss journey has led her to the semi-finals of a national competition, inspiring others in the community.

item.title: M6 Theatre Receives £73,500 Funding for 50th Anniversary Project
item.description: M6 Theatre in Rochdale has been awarded £73,500 to support its 50th anniversary project, which will include community outreach and an interactive exhibition.

item.title: Police Seize Vehicles After Drivers Fail to Stop for Heywood School Crossing Patrol
item.description: Two vehicles were seized by police in Heywood after drivers ignored a school crossing patrol, highlighting ongoing concerns about road safety near schools.

item.title: Mother and Baby Found Safe Following Police Appeal in Rochdale
item.description: A mother and her baby have been located safe and well after police conducted inquiries in the area following the discovery of human tissue.

item.title: East Lancashire Railway steam gala draws more than 2,000 passengers as numbers rise 21.4 per cent
item.description: Four visiting engines, late trains and a tribute to preservation pioneer Richard Greenwood marked a busy autumn gala on the heritage railway serving Heywood.

item.title: Urgent appeal to find woman after suspected human tissue discovered in Rochdale
item.description: Police fear a woman who may have recently given birth needs urgent medical attention after a discovery near Watkins Street and Charter Street, off Kingsway.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Women to Host COA in Home Match
item.description: Rochdale AFC Women will return to home action this weekend with a match against COA, inviting local supporters to attend and cheer on the team.

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: The tale of Lady Eleanor, Mother Bagden and the Fairies’ Chapel at Healey Dell is well attested in local printed collectors — but it survives as folklore, not as a documented medieval event.

item.description: Rochdale AFC will host an FA Youth Cup match at the Crown Oil Arena next Thursday, providing a platform for young talent in the local area.

item.title: Rochdale Council Rejects Takeaway Application on Health Grounds
item.description: Plans for a new takeaway at 159 Yorkshire Street in Rochdale have been rejected by the council due to concerns over public health and the existing number of fast-food outlets in the area.

item.title: Doorman Highlights Normalisation of Racial Abuse After Incident at Ko-Ko Lounge
item.description: Jawad Ali, a doorman at Ko-Ko Lounge in Rochdale, has raised concerns about the increasing normalisation of racial abuse following a recent incident involving a club-goer.

item.title: St Cuthbert’s RC High School Closes Following Bomb Threat
item.description: St Cuthbert’s RC High School in Rochdale was closed after a bomb threat, with all students and staff accounted for and safe. The school plans to reopen on Monday.

item.title: Martlet Kitchen in Rochdale Wins International Recognition
item.description: Martlet Kitchen, located in Rochdale, has been ranked among the top-rated restaurants globally, celebrating its second anniversary with an international award.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Invites Feedback on Proposed Customer Access Strategy
item.description: Residents are encouraged to share their views on the proposed Customer Access & Experience Strategy, which aims to enhance how the public interacts with the Council over the next five years.

item.title: M62 Eastbound Closed Near Rochdale, Motorists Warned of Delays
item.description: Motorists are advised to expect delays on the M62 eastbound near Rochdale due to a closure beyond Junction 21 on Wednesday evening, 21 October 2026.

item.description: The Martlet Kitchen, located in Rochdale Town Hall, has received the Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice Award for 2026, recognising its commitment to quality and local sourcing.

item.title: Police appeal to find missing 22-year-old Sean in Rochdale
item.description: Police are seeking help from the public to locate Sean, a 22-year-old man who went missing in Rochdale's Milkstone area on October 20. Family members describe his disappearance as unusual and urge anyone with information to come forward.

item.title: Road Closures Announced for Rochdale Bonfire and Firework Display on 4 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced temporary road closures for the Bonfire and Firework Display on 4 November 2026, affecting several key routes in the area.

item.title: Chris Cheap Appointed Managing Director of Atom Valley’s Northern Gateway Regeneration
item.description: Chris Cheap has been appointed as the new managing director of the Atom Valley Northern Gateway Mayoral Development Corporation, overseeing significant regeneration projects in Rochdale and surrounding areas.

item.title: Rochdale House Prices Rise to £211,000 in August 2026
item.description: The average house price in Rochdale increased by 3.3% over the past year, while private rents saw a significant rise of 8.8%, according to the latest figures from the Office for National Statistics.
